effect:
Raises Defense on a physical hit.

Kee Berry activates when your Pokémon takes a physical hit, giving a +1 Defense boost! It's consumed after use but can help you survive follow-up physical attacks.

This berry is useful for attackers with poor physical bulk or Pokémon that want to set up but fear physical priority moves. It's situational compared to Sitrus Berry's more universal healing, but in the right matchup, Kee Berry can swing a fight!
